title: Broccoli Stem Soup
description: A zero-waste soup made from broccoli stems, onion, garlic and potato simmered in vegetable stock and blended smooth.
ingredients: stalk and stems from 1 head of broccoli (woody parts trimmed, finely sliced)
1 potato (~150g), peeled and cut into cubes
steps: Heat a saucepan with cooking spray; add onion, garlic and broccoli stems; stir-fry gently for 6 minutes.
Add potato, stock and salt; bring to a simmer; cook gently for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a hand blender.
Serve in warmed bowls with pepper ground on top.
notes: Broccoli stems can also be sliced into coins or matchsticks for stir-fries, omelettes or raw in salads. Can also roast broccoli using the Roasted Cauliflower method (p.148).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
